questions.text: What are the top-selling smartphone brands?

summary: The smartphone market in 2023 shows continued dominance by Apple and Samsung in the premium segment, while Chinese manufacturers are expanding in the mid-range market. Consumers are prioritizing camera quality, battery life, and performance when making purchasing decisions.
